description: Return what community sources report about how people use one peptide: uses, regimens (route, amount, how often, how long), reported side effects, cautions and regulatory status notes such as US compounding policy, each line with its sources. Community-reported, not tested in trials. Use it for use, dose, cycle and compounding questions, together with studied_doses from get_peptide_brief. Seller pages are never sources. A peptide can have no record. Default compact keeps key lines, and view="full" returns every line.

peptide.description: Peptide name, alias, slug or ID. Examples: BPC-157, semaglutide, PEP-000001.
